text:
incident-bot: SEV1: prod-east-runtime — repeated container restarts in gpu pool g5x-medium. Cause suspected: OOM during prefill for very long contexts. Paging on-call.

maya (oncall-sre): I'm on it. Alerts show ~30 containers restarted within 10m, node flapping on ip-10-21-44-9. Starting triage.

sophie (eng-runtime): grabbing runtime logs now. Pattern looks like large prefill allocations then CUDA abort. Example tail:
```
2026-03-15T08:12:43Z runtime[pid=2244]: prefill: requested_tokens=142384
E runtime::gpu: cudaMemcpy failed: out of memory
E runtime::watchdog: GPU kernel crashed, resetting device
```

ryan (oncall-ml): which models and routes are hitting this? any user-facing services? Also, do we have KV cache accounting per-request?

maya (oncall-sre): top offenders: rwd-13b-quant, community-70b-int8 on long-chat endpoints /v1/chat/stream. Some internal batch inference jobs too.

kai (infra): node shows high fragmentation and large cuda allocations from pods: rwd-13b-quant-pod-*. I'll cordon node to stop scheduling and shift traffic. `kubectl cordon ip-10-21-44-9` in flight.

sam (support): seeing spike in 502/503 and a few clients reporting "service unexpectedly closed connection". Estimating ~2% of total requests impacted in east.

nina (cs): flagging top customers with long-context usage. Reaching out to enterprise contacts to preempt questions.

sophie (eng-runtime): quick mitigation we can roll: 1) enforce soft prefill cap at routing (send X-Prefill-Trim header), 2) trigger immediate KV eviction after prefill failure, 3) reduce prefill batch size to prevent contiguous large allocs. Preparing patch.

deploy-bot: creating canary: runtime:v2026-03-395-hotfix-prefill-evict -> 2 pods in prod-east.

ryan (oncall-ml): while deploying, recommend adding a 429 guard for single requests >80k tokens to avoid hammering the KV allocator. We can return 429 + "Retry-After" and header X-Context-Processed when we truncate.

maya (oncall-sre): applying temporary routing rule to reject >96k prefill with 429. Rule applied to east region. This should stop the largest offenders immediately.

kai (infra): cordon completed and draining node ip-10-21-44-9. Evicted 22 pods; fallback pool capacity absorbing ~70% of traffic. Spun up 4 extra smaller-gpu instances for headroom.

sophie (eng-runtime): canary logs show prefill memory usage reduced by ~60% for patched pods. No restarts in canary for 7m while handling sampled traffic.

sam (support): affected customer list (from last 15m): alpha-retail (partial errors), docu-ml (spikes in latency), sandbox-internal (restarts). CS notified.

nina (cs): drafting message: "We observed a service disruption causing failures for very long context generations in east. We've applied mitigations; some requests may be trimmed or receive retry headers. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." :email:

ryan (oncall-ml): capturing GPU stacks and allocator metrics for crashed pods. Commands:
```
kubectl exec -n runtime <pod> -- cat /var/log/runtime/mem-alloc.log | tail -n 200
nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY
```
Uploading to /incidents/3950001234/artifacts.

sophie (eng-runtime): promoting hotfix to 50% rollout. Will monitor for additional CUDA resets.

deploy-bot: rollout to 50% started.

incident-bot: metrics update: OOM-driven restarts fell from 24/min to 1.6/min after throttles and canary. Error budget burn reduced.

maya (oncall-sre): holding stabilization window 20m. If stable, gradually relax prefill throttle to 64k then 96k.

kai (infra): added autoscaling template to prefer smaller batch-capacity nodes during prefill surges. Will follow up with infra PR.

sophie (eng-runtime): final step: implement a graceful prefill-trim that preserves most of the prefix, and add X-Context-Truncated header. Filed PR: #runtime/1247 (OWNER: eng-runtime). Also adding telemetry to track prefill truncations.

ryan (oncall-ml): post-incident actions: revise KV memory accounting, add priority-based eviction (system prompts > user messages), and run load test with synthetic 120k token prefill to validate.

sam (support): customer comms sent to impacted accounts. Support cases flagged and CS triage on standby.

nina (cs): will send postmortem template and coordinate customer follow-ups. ETA for detailed update: 24h.

incident-bot: incident state -> mitigated (monitoring). SEV1 -> shift to follow-up review in 4h. Please file follow-ups and assign owners.

maya (oncall-sre): ACTION ITEMS:
- sophie: final PR for graceful prefill trimming + header (OWNER: eng-runtime)
- ryan: KV-growth analysis + eviction thresholds (OWNER: oncall-ml)
- kai: autoscale & node-type policy changes (OWNER: infra)
- nina/sam: customer updates and support summary (OWNER: cs/support)

sophie (eng-runtime): promoted hotfix to 100% at t+28m. No further restarts observed on patched fleet for 25m.

maya (oncall-sre): closing active pager. If anyone observes regressions re-open with P1. Thanks all for fast coordination. \n
